description: This source file contains utility functions for testing infrastructure in an Orleans project, including methods to check for Azure Storage, EventHub, and Redis connections, timing calibration, thread pool configuration, and grain activation counting. It also includes a utility class for managing request activity IDs.

classes.name: TestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for testing and infrastructure checks in Orleans-based test environments.

classes.name: RequestContextTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class for managing request activity IDs within the context of Orleans request processing.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Generates a random grain ID using shared randomness.

methods.name: CheckForAzureStorage
methods.description: Checks if Azure Storage connection settings are configured, starts storage emulator if needed.

methods.name: CheckForEventHub
methods.description: Checks if Event Hub connection settings are configured.

methods.name: CheckForRedis
methods.description: Checks if Redis connection string is configured.

methods.name: ForceTlsVersion
methods.description: Forces the security protocol to TLS 1.2.

methods.name: CalibrateTimings
methods.description: Measures timing calibration by running an empty loop.

methods.name: TimeRunAsync
methods.description: Runs an async action multiple times, measuring duration and memory usage.

methods.name: ConfigureClientThreadPoolSettingsForStorageTests
methods.description: Configures .NET thread pool and ServicePointManager settings for storage tests.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Retrieves the activation count for a specific grain type via management grain.
